sources.gws-design: Auditex M13 design for SCuBA on Google Workspace (gws-scuba/design.md, owner records): section 8.3 rows D1-D10 and the 25 Nov 2026 addendum rows D11-D22 (cited as 8.3a); policy scope from its section 14 per-policy table (kind and not_assessed reasons)
sources.m365-spec: Auditex value-rules spec v3.9.1 replay vectors (sha256 3515b6facbac73091ef43bfa51b746e9265ac508909103ffcc016a5dab92cf4e): every vector whose disagreement reads 'expected: Dnn', grouped by policy and Dnn

gws-design.D1: ScubaGoggles: no setting event with a safe default reads as safe; Auditex: not_assessed (unknown is not safe)
gws-design.D2: ScubaGoggles: an absent setting outside its expected table passes; Auditex: not_assessed
gws-design.D3: ScubaGoggles: an absent top-level service status counts as disabled and passes; Auditex: not_assessed
gws-design.D4: ScubaGoggles reads the GMAIL.7.3 field for GMAIL.7.5; Auditex reads detectGroupsSpoofing, as the baseline says
gws-design.D5: ScubaGoggles passes CC.1.4 grace periods under one day; Auditex: not_met below 86,400 seconds
gws-design.D6: ScubaGoggles fails CC.10.1 with no API-controls section; Auditex: not_assessed when the whole section is absent
gws-design.D7: ScubaGoggles reads option only for CC.7.1; Auditex reads option, else conflictingAccountsManagement
gws-design.D8: ScubaGoggles compares 2SV dates with the wall clock; Auditex with the run's as_of
gws-design.D9: ScubaGoggles excludes configured break-glass accounts in CC.6.2; Auditex has no exclusion input
gws-design.D10: ScubaGoggles: Error after a failed prerequisite call; Auditex: section_not_collected or a read_incomplete reason
gws-design.D11: ScubaGoggles: the first of two equal-ranked units wins; Auditex: the tie is unusable, not_assessed
gws-design.D12: ScubaGoggles: an unrecognised serviceState is off; Auditex: unknown, not_assessed
gws-design.D13: ScubaGoggles: CC.6.2 with no super admins passes or errors; Auditex: not_assessed
gws-design.D14: ScubaGoggles: an unknown 2SV or SSO enum value is compliant; Auditex: not_assessed
gws-design.D15: ScubaGoggles: a top-level DELETE_APPLICATION_SETTING counts as an event; Auditex: no setting event, not_assessed
gws-design.D16: ScubaGoggles: an event value outside the good value fails; Auditex: outside the pinned good and bad values is unusable
gws-design.D17: ScubaGoggles: CHAT.5.1 ignores a child unit without all four event types; Auditex judges each setting per unit
gws-design.D18: ScubaGoggles places a GEMINI.1.1 group event in the event's unit; Auditex has no unit for it
gws-design.D19: ScubaGoggles reports no top event before a child-unit violation; Auditex: the child violation is not_met
gws-design.D20: ScubaGoggles reads own values only for DRIVEDOCS.3.1, CHAT.4.1, CC.11.1; Auditex combines own and inherited
gws-design.D21: ScubaGoggles skips sub-units without own values under a top unit with the service off; Auditex judges inherited values
gws-design.D22: ScubaGoggles ignores non-DMARC TXT records at _dmarc; Auditex reads a mixed set strictly
